title: Zesty Smoked Uruguayan Peas Gratin
description: A comforting dish featuring roasted uruguayan peas in a zesty hoisin sauce and lacquer-glaze, served on a salt-block for added texture.
instructions: Rinse and pick out any debris from the Urupeñas. Pat dry with paper towels.
Mix hoisin sauce and lacquer-glaze in a bowl until well combined.
Place Urupeñas on a baking sheet, brush lightly with olive oil (if preferred), then pour the sauce mixture over each pea evenly.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over the peas, ensuring even coverage. Pat down to adhere if necessary.
Bake at 200 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes or until edges start to crisp up and turn golden brown.
Transfer cooked Urupeñas onto a preheated salt block for serving. Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves before serving.
